title: Constructible and normalized towers
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and a scheme $T$. Put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ and $R_n=(A_n)_T=\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$, with $q_{n,m}:R_n\to R_m$ for $1\leq m\leq n$ the composite of the consecutive quotient maps ($q_{n,n}=1$), and use the coefficient-tower category $\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], indexed by $n\geq1$. Use its ordinary derived category $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; for $C_\bullet$ in this category, $C_n$ is its image under the exact level evaluation of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian].

For the finite ring $A_n$, write $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A_n)$ for the full subcategory of $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A_n)$ consisting of complexes with finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], all constructible in the sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and finite Tor amplitude in the sense of [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude].

Define $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ to be the full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ consisting of objects $C_\bullet$ whose levels lie in $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A_n)$ and for which there exist integers $a\leq b$ and $u\leq v$, independent of $n$, such that $\mathcal H^i(C_n)=0$ for $i\notin[a,b]$ and every $C_n$ has Tor amplitude in $[u,v]$.

Such a tower is *normalized* if for every $1\leq m\leq n$ the canonical reduction map of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]
$$C_n\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_n}R_m\longrightarrow C_m$$
is an isomorphism in $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A_m)$. Denote the full subcategory of normalized towers by $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)_{\mathrm{norm}}$. In both full subcategories the morphisms are precisely the morphisms of the ambient derived category between the specified objects.
